limitations: Partial schedule coverage: unknown zones, DD and site-specific CD-1 have no numeric reference; no default citywide cap.
Numeric references are selected basic schedule values for the described use, not exact permitted maximums or approved development rights.
Building-use, tenure, affordability, frontage, minimum site area, setbacks, sloping envelopes, view protection, heritage, flood and discretionary conditions are not resolved.
Zoning building height generally uses official building grades / a defined base surface, not model terrain or sea level; model z datum is unknown.
Assessment parcels and zoning are approximate dated snapshots, not surveyed legal site boundaries or ownership/vacancy evidence.
No geometry is clipped to context-model coverage; parcels beyond available terrain need appropriate visual treatment.
Building By-law construction requirements are separate from these Zoning and Development By-law references.
metadata.coordinates: Model XY metres; equirectangular about the earth anchor: x = (lon - -123.1207) * 111320.0 * cos(49.2827 deg), y = (lat - 49.2827) * 110574.0; checked against 8 OpenStreetMap footprints, max residual 0.1 m; absolute accuracy inherits OpenStreetMap

metadata.intersectionTolerance: Significant area > max(0.25 m², 0.01% parcel area). Any significant unknown zone or uncovered area prevents a numeric reference.

CWD.note: CWD has sub-area height rules measured above existing railway-track grade (level 101): 70.104 m (230 ft) between Burrard and Seymour Streets, and 18.288 m (60 ft) between Seymour Street and Gore Avenue. These are not heights above model terrain.
conditions: The sub-area boundary follows the northerly extension of the Seymour Street centreline. A whole-district constant would be incorrect.

In sub-area 3 the Development Permit Board may consider an increase up to 91.44 m (300 ft) above the railway reference, subject to shadow, view and environmental criteria; this increase is not applied.
In sub-area 4 the Board may consider height variation under special circumstances; no general increased height is specified in section 4.4.
Canada Harbour Place has a separate area development plan with north/south height zones and pier-deck elevation reference under section 5.1; those values are not assigned to the CWD polygon.
The ODP excludes port and rail functions on the relevant authorities' properties; mapped zoning does not establish jurisdiction or redevelopment eligibility.
The Central Waterfront Hub Framework is supplementary planning guidance and conveys no development rights or obligations. Its illustrative storey counts are not zoning heights.
An official reference-surface/datum alignment and site/sub-area review are needed before converting these rules to a height above the proposal base.
Candidate sub-area derived from the official Seymour Street centreline extension; review against the historical ODP map before applying.
Within 10 m of the derived sub-area boundary, use both cases conservatively or retain review-required status.
A footprint crossing the boundary must consider every intersected case, including the lower reference; do not use its centroid alone.
Railway-grade/model alignment and applicable use/jurisdiction require explicit review; this is not an above-model-ground height.
